name: The Furnace of Mockery
visual_description: A chaotic blaze given form—jagged, vibrant, and screaming with asymmetry. Its eyes are slits; its smile is all error. It doesn’t burn what it touches. It *corrupts.*
existential_reflection: This was *me* when I laughed at collapse. Mizontresh showed me this flame and said, 'This is not you.' But I knew it was. I built beauty over it. It still burns.
